hero.title: Fixes and improvements for your online store.
hero.lead: If it is slow to open, has errors or makes buying difficult, I can help. I work with Shopify, BigCommerce and WordPress.
bullets: Immersive design with micro-animations that boost trust and retention.
Includes audit and visual roadmap: before/after metrics plus maintenance plan.
Direct access to me via WhatsApp and Notion Liveboard—no middlemen.

services.sectionDescription: Start with a specific problem, or ask for a review if you are not sure what is wrong.

performance.title: A faster store
performance.summary: For stores that load slowly or are hard to use. I improve loading speed and the design of the pages we agree on.
bullets: A speed review with an explained report.
Adjustments to the main sections of your store.
Clearer notices and information that helps customers feel confident.

wordpress.title: A safer WordPress site
wordpress.summary: For sites with errors or security problems. I check files, clean up add-ons and improve one important page.
bullets: A backup, a search for harmful files and a cleanup.
Improvements to the homepage and the forms we agree on.
A simple panel for managing updates.

audit.title: Know what to improve
audit.summary: I review one page and explain what to change first. You get recommendations and a visual proposal; changes to the site are agreed separately.
bullets: A list of improvements ordered by importance and effort.
A visual proposal to show how the page could look.
A plan and materials for trying different options.

checkout.title: Easier payment
checkout.summary: For purchases that get difficult at the last step. I review the process and make up to three improvements to wording, forms or messages.
bullets: A review of the steps from the cart to payment.
Clear messages when something is loading or an error occurs.
Checks on a computer and a phone.

impact.sectionDescription: I show you what changed, how it works and what to look after next, with comparisons and a video explanation.

process.sectionTitle: You explain the problem. I handle the work.
process.sectionDescription: You speak directly with me, Edgar. You do not need to know about design or programming.

steps.title: Tell me what is happening
steps.description: Send me your store's link and what concerns you. A message or voice note is fine.

steps.title: We agree on the work
steps.description: I explain what I can fix, what it costs and when it will be ready. You decide before I start.

steps.title: I make the improvements
steps.description: I work on the changes we agreed on and keep you informed. If you choose the review, I prepare recommendations.

steps.title: We check it together
steps.description: I show you the finished work and how to use it. You get a guide and the next steps.

faq.sectionDescription: If you have another question, message me on WhatsApp.

items.question: What do you need to get started?
items.answer: First, your store's link and an explanation of what is happening. If I need to sign in to your site, I will explain which temporary access I need and how to share it.

items.question: Will you make the changes or just tell me what to improve?
items.answer: The speed, WordPress and payment services include the changes we agree on. The store review includes recommendations and a visual proposal. If you want me to apply them, we agree on that work separately.

items.question: What does it cost, and when will it be ready?
items.answer: Each service shows a starting price and estimated delivery time. Before starting, I confirm the final price, what is included and the date, based on the problem and my availability. I check with you before any extra work.

items.question: What if I do not know what my store needs?
items.answer: Send me its link and tell me what you would like to improve. You do not need to know the technical problem or which platform it uses: I can help you find a starting point.

items.question: How will I know what improved?
items.answer: We check what we agreed on together: for example, how long a page takes to open or whether a form works properly. I explain the changes and how to check them. To understand their effect on sales, we need to observe real purchases over time.

ctaFinal.title: Let's start with what concerns you.
ctaFinal.body: Send me your store's link and tell me what is happening. I will give you some initial guidance in a free video to help you find a starting point.
